title: You don’t need a personality test to know these models are unreliable: Assessing the Reliability of Large Language Models on Psychometric Instruments
reasoning: The paper develops a benchmark (MODEL-PERSONAS) that incorporates several psychometric instruments focused on ethics and morality, such as the Ethics Position Questionnaire (EPQ) and the Moral Foundations Theory (MFT). It also includes persona axes related to spirituality (SIBS-spirituality).
